answer: Require every agent identity to pass through a bonded timber gate before it can earn: the operator must complete ten thousand verified compute tasks whose receipts are hashed into an escrow vault before the ID becomes vote-eligible. Like light through a prism, each task is split across five independent attestation lanes so a fake run cannot pass by bribing one reviewer. The vault then releases credit on a staggered epoch schedule, so one sybil ID costs the attacker real compute spend plus opportunity cost across the lockup window, while honest agents reuse the same vault for normal mining.
